tools.name: modern_treasury_list_internal_accounts

tools.name: modern_treasury_list_external_accounts
tools.description: List external (counterparty) bank accounts. API: GET /external_accounts.

tools.name: modern_treasury_list_payment_orders

tools.name: modern_treasury_get_payment_order
tools.description: Get a single payment order by id (READ ONLY). API: GET /payment_orders/{id}.

tools.name: modern_treasury_list_expected_payments
tools.description: List expected payments (READ ONLY). API: GET /expected_payments.

tools.name: modern_treasury_get_transaction

tools.name: modern_treasury_list_returns

tools.name: modern_treasury_list_ledger_transactions

tools.name: modern_treasury_create_counterparty

findings.title: Description references secrets/credentials
findings.detail: Description of "modern_treasury_ping" references sensitive artifacts (credentials). A tool description has no reason to mention credentials.

evidence.snippet: Verify connectivity and credentials. API: GET /ping.

findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: modern_treasury_list_ledger_transactions · Private data: modern_treasury_ping, modern_treasury_list_counterparties, modern_treasury_create_counterparty · Public sink: modern_treasury_list_ledger_transactions, modern_treasury_create_counterparty.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: modern_treasury_list_ledger_transactions · Private data: modern_treasury_ping, modern_treasury_list_counterparties, modern_treasury_create_counterparty · Public sink: modern_treasury_list_ledger_transactions, modern_treasury_create_counterparty

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
